objects.contents: crystal key, crystal elixir, coins x150

objects.name: Seer Oriel
objects.greeting: Hush. They hear through the thin places.|The blooms drink what comes down through the sky. I would know what it is they are drinking.
objects.topics: The serpents=Vérnees. They fall out of the holes in the sky and climb back before dawn. Strike when they dive.; The road=East, past the pool, the Vale ends. Beyond the gate the main lands go on.

objects.title: Blooms for the seer
objects.offer: Four crystal blooms from the hollow - picked, not cut. The serpents will not thank you for it.
objects.remind: The blooms grow low, among the crystal grass round the pool.
objects.thanks: Still humming. Yes. Take these: the dust is theirs, the storm is mine.
objects.reward: crystal dust x6, scroll of the storm x1, coins x100
